ngaap.notes: EBITDA build (as published in this release): NI attributable to Vulcan + income tax expense (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + LOSS ON DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS NET OF TAX + DDA&A. The discontinued-ops add-back sits in the EBITDA build, not in the EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA bridge, so adj_items.disc_ops = 0 and the schema check ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub is short by exactly ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_aftertax (1.8); it ties when that field is included. Business development footnote: non-routine charges or gains associated with acquisitions and dispositions. Restructuring charges listed separately in this period's bridge. Adjusted EPS bridge starts at diluted EPS from continuing operations. 'Acquisition financing interest costs' (0.00 where shown) counted in items. Discrete tax = Calica NOL carryforward valuation allowance. ROIC = TTM Adjusted EBITDA / 5-quarter average invested capital, in percent.
